kit.noMatches: Nothing matches this search. Clear the search or try another word.

error.title: This page did not load
error.sentence: Something went wrong while reading this page. Try again; if it keeps failing, contact your administrator with the reference below.

errors.title: Not saved
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.notFound: You may not have access to change this, or it no longer exists. Ask an Admin for access, or reload the page.
errors.conflict: Another item already uses this name or code. Choose a different one.
errors.invalid: One of the values is not allowed. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.refused: The system refused this change. Check the values and try again, or ask an Admin.
errors.capability_document_frozen: This document is frozen and can never change. Add a new document for the new version.
errors.jurisdiction_no_answer: No answer: the project's jurisdiction is unresolved or not yet populated in canon, so the permit engine cannot say which permits apply. Set a populated jurisdiction on the project first.
errors.permit_requirement_tracked: A Permit record already tracks this requirement. Open that record instead.
errors.inspection_signed_off: This inspection is signed off, so its results are frozen. Start a new inspection to record new findings.
errors.inspection_item_template: That item belongs to another template. Reload the inspection and try again.
errors.sod_approval_requester: The inspector cannot sign off their own inspection. Ask another person with sign-off rights.
errors.venue_location_pair: Enter both a latitude and a longitude, or leave both blank.
errors.venue_location_range: Latitude runs from -90 to 90 and longitude from -180 to 180.
errors.time_zone_unknown: That time zone is not in the IANA list. Choose one from the list.
errors.record_blocker_required: Name what is blocking the permit before you mark it Blocked.
errors.record_replan_reason_required: Give a replan reason before you defer the permit.
errors.record_title_grammar: The title must name the permit as a noun phrase, without closing punctuation.
errors.record_transition_not_allowed: That state change is not allowed from the current state. Choose one of the offered states.
errors.record_state_conflict: Someone changed this record a moment ago. Reload to see the current state, then try again.
errors.transition_reason_required: Give a reason for the state change.
errors.production_closed: This project's production is closed, so nothing new can be added to it.
errors.enumeration_domain: That result is not one of the canon inspection results. Choose one from the list.
errors.fileTooLarge: Files can be at most 50 MB. Choose a smaller file.
errors.fileScanning: This file is still being scanned. Try the download again in a minute.
errors.postal_code_invalid: That postal code does not fit the venue's country. Check it against the address, or choose the right jurisdiction.

reconciliation.title: Requirements and Capability
reconciliation.intro: List what the production requires and what venues provide, then reconcile. A requirement with no claim, or only an UNKNOWN claim, reconciles as Unknown, never Met; a Gap or an Unknown on a critical requirement is a gate 3 gap.
reconciliation.neverRun: Not reconciled yet. Add requirements and capabilities, then run a reconciliation.
reconciliation.gapsTitle: {count, plural, one {# gate 3 gap} other {# gate 3 gaps}}
reconciliation.gapsBody: Close each gap with a capability that covers it, or record a stronger claim, then reconcile again.
reconciliation.noGaps: No gate 3 gaps in the latest reconciliation.
reconciliation.noRequirements: No requirements yet. Add what the production needs below.
reconciliation.noCapabilities: No capabilities yet. Add what a venue provides below.

fields.critical: Critical: an Unknown here is a gate 3 gap
fields.assertionHelp: From canon: certified is strongest, unknown means no claim.
